method: Built-in imagegen; silver master tinted gold and assembled programmatically.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: separate central CHAMPION CROWN emblem for a metallic hexagonal badge, transparent PNG.
Input image 1 is the current podium comparison, COMPOSITION AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. We are replacing the large numeral 1 inside the first gold Champion badge with a crown. Input image 2 is its silver top crest, MATERIAL AND BEVEL REFERENCE ONLY. Do not reproduce the complete badges, the comparison sheet, or the top crest.
Generate ONLY ONE unmistakable classic royal crown icon, front-facing orthographic and exactly bilaterally symmetric. A broad solid horizontal base band with chamfered corners supports three strong upright pointed peaks: tall central point and two shorter outer points, with two deep V-shaped dips between them. The outer points flare slightly outward. A small stepped inset line along the band adds depth. Clear crown silhouette, not leaves, wings, a trident or a separate floating crest. No circular ornaments, jewels, text, numerals, stars, crosses or coat of arms. Roughly 1.55 times as wide as tall. Compact, bold, and legible at small game UI sizes.
Use neutral SILVER/charcoal metal ONLY so it can be tinted gold programmatically: broad crisp polished bevels, smooth brushed gray faces, bright white specular highlights, deep charcoal inset shadows. Match the reference's machined metallic material. All parts connected. Entire crown visible, centered with a little transparent padding. Genuine alpha transparency outside, in the open dips between the points, and wherever empty. No badge, plate, laurels, backdrop, glow, cast shadow, lettering or watermark. One independent reusable crown asset.
